snippet.title: Age of the Fallen – Official Launch Trailer | August 28, 2026
snippet.description:
Age of the Fallen launches August 28, 2026 on Steam!

Dive into frenetic Bullet Heaven action, build devastating combinations through cards and upgrades, uncover secrets across 8 action-packed levels, and face the chaos alone or in local co-op.

🔥 Over 128 million offensive combinations
⚔️ Fast-paced Bullet Heaven combat
🃏 Card & upgrade system
🗺️ 8 levels packed with secrets, items & quests
👥 Story Mode & Local Co-op

Wishlist & play on Steam
